title: [v0.108.0 ONLY] Multiplayer Card Bugfixes: THE_BALL & Underworld
description:
Fixes two multiplayer card bugs in Slay the Spire 2 v0.108.0. Both were officially patched in v0.109.0+; this mod backports the fixes for players still on v0.108.0.

Bug 1 (THE_BALL): After playing THE_BALL and passing it to another player, some effects incorrectly treat the recipient as the caster, causing unexpected behavior and even desyncs in multiplayer.

Bug 2 (Underworld / 幽冥之界): Underworld is meant to inflict Doom on enemies only when players deal attack damage. Due to a logic flaw, enemy attacks against players also trigger the effect, wrongly applying Doom to players.

This mod only activates on v0.108.0 and automatically disables on v0.109.0 or later.

Github: https://github.com/xiting910/TheBallFix
